title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode7 Try Until You Succeed

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'm glad that I was able to buy some more flip cards for my stream. Now I just need to buy some new dance shoes, and...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(They're passing out flyers...?
That takes me back. Are they a new idol group?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That's nice. They get to share their hopes with the world on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, did you see Airi's stream yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Yeah, she drew questions to answer from a box, right?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Yeah! I laughed so hard every time she made a quip about the comments people posted.

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: She's like a professional comedian in that sense. I really wanna see her on variety shows again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I should probably give them a wide berth so they don't see me...)

Oh, you there with the cat bag!
Do you have a minute?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello, we're Pop☆Drop!
We're doing a show soon! Would you be interested in seeing it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We'll leave you 1,000% satisf—
Wait, what?! Y-You're Airi Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
H-Hey, calm down!
Can't you be a little quieter?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no! I-I'm sorry!
I couldn't help myself!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, more importantly...!
Would you be interested in seeing our show?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Compared to an incredible idol such as yourself, we're not very good...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we promise to do everything we can to give you a big boost of cheerful energy! So, please...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, I appreciate the thought.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You came straight over to me just now.
You didn't seem to realize that it was me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You seemed to be feeling a little down just now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh...! But it looks like I was wrong, so I might've just imagined all that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She's making a genuine effort to make me feel better...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can I have one of those flyers?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Darn it. I'm running late now after shooting that video...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. I think I made it in time...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Seriously, you don't have to jump up and down like that. I see you just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(See? She lost her balance.
She seems so clumsy.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Also, for this routine, I really think she should stretch your arms out more gracefully instead of sticking them out like that.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Even though her position's in the back, she's got a big smile on her face, and she's really putting her whole body into it. You can tell that she's doing her best to spread hope to others.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If you're having trouble doing that, then you just gotta keep trying until you succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I don't believe that all hard work alone will definitely be rewarded or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I do believe that you will connect with someone as long as you genuinely do your best to spread hope to everyone.)

I think you'll become one, Airi.
A super idol who can do it all.
We promise to give you all the support we can so that you can keep moving forward with optimism♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I have no idea what happened...
But what they said was really encouraging.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In order to finally make my dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Homeroom dragged on for a really long time.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've gotta get home and start getting ready for my dance stream.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I left school in such a hurry that I left all my flyers back in the classroom...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming to yesterday's show!
I was so happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for inviting me.
I thought it was really good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know. Why don't we have lunch together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I want to tell you what else I thought. Remember how you had a little trouble with that once dance? I'll give you some pointers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. I'm the one who's offering!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, thank you so much...!
I can't wait!!
